correctness.rationale: The n distinct intermediate one-insertion words are partitioned by unique VT extensions. All but at most two resulting parent fibers have cardinality at least two, giving L<=floor(n/2)+1. Explicit constructions for all parities and every syndrome provide exactly floor(n/2)+1 distinct parents. Independent exhaustive n=3..13 and all-constructions n=3..80 checks reproduce the claim; the infinite proof is analytic.
